scenes.title: Dupixent cliff, fence falls
scenes.hero: DUPIXENT column on its broken ledge
scenes.note: a ledge with a fenced white column springs in from depth; DUPIXENT prints on 'Dupixent'; on 'cliff' the ledge's lip breaks off and falls (camera cranes down with it); on 'loses exclusivity' the EXCLUSIVITY fence falls flat toward us and slides off; EARLY NEXT DECADE drops; on 'needs' an empty NEXT GROWTH STORY? pedestal springs up below as the camera pulls back

scenes.title: knob turns to respiratory
scenes.note: a selector knob springs in from depth pointing at IMMUNOLOGY; POST-DUPIXENT BET drops on 'post-Dupixent'; on 'immunology' the knob turns (one overshoot) to RESPIRATORY, which lights red, as the camera pushes in

scenes.title: cheque returns unsigned
scenes.hero: the $30B+ cheque with a red ? on its signature line
scenes.note: callback: the hook's $30B+ cheque (REPORTED) springs back into its own seat; AFFORDABILITY drops on 'affordability'; on 'question' a red ? falls onto the empty signature line and squashes once (camera cranes down with it): unsigned, no deal
